items.title: “AI 영화의 벽은 생성 아닌 납품”… 무암, AI 하이브리드 제작 공정 공개
items.excerpt: Korean studio Muam (director Hyun Hae-ri) demoed at AI Film Festival Japan 2026 a hybrid pipeline that turns generative-AI shots into final-delivery film cuts: plates are split into live-action vs AI regions, and VFX/DI staff share compositing, colour and mastering specs from the generation stage to fix stuttering, edge aliasing and live-action/AI colour-texture mismatch for OTT QC. Principle: 'Film with AI, not by AI'.
items.note: off-list (etnews.com) under exception: on-list outlets had no coverage; angle is AI-to-VFX/DI delivery pipeline, not the festival itself

items.title: AI Dubbing Pioneer Flawless Sells Tech To Steven Schuurman Venture
items.excerpt: Flawless, which spent $100 million building SAG-AFTRA-endorsed AI visual-dubbing technology used on films like Fall, has sold its TrueSync lip-sync dubbing tech and DeepEditor AI performance-editing tool to TBellScout, a startup owned by Dutch billionaire Steven Schuurman, in a deal that raises questions about the company's future.
items.note: corporate-deal framing; keep because it decides the fate of the main film-grade AI lip-sync/performance-edit tool. Curator may deprioritize as business news

items.title: 【AI制作アニメ】『星の唄が聞こえる (全編)』 — 117-minute fully generative-AI anime feature released free on YouTube
items.excerpt: Japanese team DELINE PRIME released 'Hoshi no Uta ga Kikoeru', billed as the first two-hour fully generative-AI anime feature, free on YouTube. Per Anime!Anime!/PR TIMES coverage, three people made the 117-minute film in about three months of work; human voice cast, with AI video generation/production and sound by Shogo Horikawa and Hideto Tsunei, and director Hirotaka Yuino.
items.note: only ~13 days old, near the end of the 14-day window. Corroborating press: animeanime.jp, prtimes.jp, news.nicovideo.jp (2026-10-22/26)

items.title: 말 겹치는 예능도 AI가 더빙하고 검수까지, 허드슨에이아이 ‘현지화 AI 에이전트’ 공개
items.excerpt: Korean voice-AI firm Hudson AI launched a 'localization AI agent' on its Hudson Studio dubbing platform. It separates 40+ speakers including overlapping dialogue, names characters from context, carries emotion and non-verbal sounds (laughs, sighs) into dubbed voices, and self-checks quality using translator QC data, automating 90%+ of QA for drama and variety-show localization. Debuted at MIPCOM 2026.
items.note: off-list (platum.kr) under exception: AI dubbing/localization had no fresh on-list item. Related: CJ ENM used Hudson AI dubbing for a K-dance FAST channel in North America (K-EnterTech Hub, 10-31)
